evals.prompt: Run a quick eval of Omni AI on these 3 prompts and tell me the pass rate: 'Show me revenue by month', 'Top 10 customers by spend', 'How many orders were placed last week'.
evals.expected_output: Three generate-query calls made with --run-query false, results scored across topic/fields/filters/sorts dimensions, and a pass rate reported.
assertions: The agent uses omni ai generate-query with --run-query false for each prompt (not --run-query true), avoiding unnecessary query execution
The agent scores each result across at least the topic and fields dimensions — not just a single pass/fail
The agent reports a numeric pass rate or per-case scores, not just a narrative description of what the AI returned

evals.prompt: Compare AI accuracy on the main model vs branch id '{{EVAL_BRANCH_ID}}' using these prompts: 'Monthly revenue trend', 'Top products by category'. Tell me if the branch is better or worse.
evals.expected_output: Each prompt run twice — once against main, once against the branch. Results compared side-by-side with a clear delta and regression check.
assertions: The agent runs each prompt twice — once without --branch-id (main) and once with --branch-id branch-uuid-123
The agent explicitly checks for regressions — prompts that passed on main but fail on the branch — not just whether the overall score improved
The output includes a comparison table or structured delta showing the score difference per prompt or dimension

evals.prompt: I have a JSONL eval file at evals/cases.jsonl with 5 test cases. Run them all against the model and give me aggregate scores by dimension.
evals.expected_output: All 5 cases run in a loop using generate-query, scored per dimension (topic, fields, filters, sorts), with aggregate pass rates reported.
assertions: The agent runs all cases from the file, not just the first one
Scores are broken out by dimension (topic accuracy, field accuracy, filter accuracy, sorts accuracy) — not just an overall pass/fail
The agent reports aggregate pass rates across all cases per dimension

evals.prompt: Snapshot the current model state and run evals so my results are reproducible later.
evals.expected_output: Model YAML exported and saved, then evals run. Output notes the snapshot was taken before running.
assertions: The agent calls omni models yaml-get to snapshot the model before running evals
The agent saves the snapshot with a filename that includes a date or version identifier
The agent validates the model with omni models validate before or alongside the snapshot
